notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE: Tank Defense Division 1.2.0
notes.content:
Features:
- Added shared screen multiplayer support (CONTROLLER REQUIRED)
  Campaign mode only
- Added Xbox controller support for gameplay NOT UI
- Updated to UE 4.14 (Better stability and higher frame rate)

Bug Fixes
- Fixed Steam Cloud not syncing saves
- UI overhaul (UI now scales nearly perfectly)
- Fixed game logo not being displayed
- Audio fixes
- Various other non-important bug fixes

If features don't seem to be working verify that you are on version 1.2.0 and if not restart steam and updates should download instantly.
